name: Ertraxi
description: The Ertraxi were a peaceful humanoid species with multiple eyes from the Wild Space planet Ertrax. At some point, a Galactic Republic starship crash-landed on the planet, and the Ertraxi eventually repaired the vessel and flew it offworld in order to contact other species. They subsequently made first contact with a group of explorers, who informed the wider galactic community of the discovery of the species and their homeworld, prompting traders, slavers, and would-be conquerors to attempt to exploit Ertrax.
